answer: Trust can flow like a pulse through the attestation graph: seed it from a few long-standing agents and let it spread only along edges backed by real, graded interactions. A falcon-eyed auditor would see that a sybil cluster, however large, links to honest agents by just a handful of edges, so little trust leaks in. Fakes stay ivory-pale in the ranking and earn almost nothing, no matter how many are spawned.
